title: Desi Boyz
desc: A comedy-drama film about two friends, who lose their jobs during the recession. They decide to become male escorts to make ends meet, hiding their new profession from their families. However, their lives become more complicated when they fall in love and have to deal with the consequences of their new careers. Their lives take a turn when their secret is exposed, leading to a series of comical situations and misunderstandings.

title: Sunday
desc: Voice actress Sehar wakes with a hangover to find she’s lost an entire day. As she retraces Sunday’s events, she becomes the prime suspect in a murder, chased by a gangster and an unhinged cabbie, Ballu.

title: Karobaar : The Business Of Love
desc: Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.
